products.name: Comet ML
products.note: ML experiment management; model monitoring; production tracking; team collaboration

profile_text.body:
Comet describes itself as an AI developer platform and the creator of Opik, which it characterizes as an end-to-end AI observability platform aimed at developers building generative AI applications and agents. Opik covers LLM tracing, agent testing, prompt engineering, and production monitoring, and the company says it offers more than 60 integrations for instrumentation along with more than 40 LLM-as-a-judge evaluation metrics. The platform also includes a Cost Intelligence feature for tracking Claude Code and Codex usage across engineering teams, with the stated goal of eliminating wasted tokens and improving efficiency across model selection, context retrieval, and configurations.

Alongside Opik, Comet offers its longer-standing MLOps product, Comet ML, which the site describes as covering experiment management, model versioning, dataset management, custom visualizations, and production monitoring, accessible by adding a few lines of code to an existing project. The company positions these two products together as a full lifecycle offering, from early experimentation through to production governance and cost tracking.

The held facts confirm Comet ML is catalogued under Coding and Developer Tools, and the company's profile on this site was verified in August 2026. No litigation, SEC filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
